title: Victorinox Swiss Classic Utility-Colored 4½" Serrated Round Blade ¾ width at handle Yellow, 2.1, Multi

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.body: I am turning 52 years this year and have been cutting vegetables since I was 12 years old and this knife has been the best knife till day. Highly recommended for tomatoes and vegetables
reviews.author: vani

reviews.title: Coupe parfaitement
reviews.body: Couteau qui ne paye pas de mine quand on le reçoit, surtout pour un victorinoxPar contre, coupe parfaitement les tomates et autres légumes du même typeBonne prise en main et on reconnait la qualité du fabricant historique
reviews.author: Laurent

reviews.title: Super-sharp and great for cutting fruits and vegetables
reviews.body: Great paring knife.  Super-sharp which seems to last for quite a while.  I usually replace them every year because the price is fair and less expensive than having them sharpened.  I prefer the serrated knife that has a pointed tip but unfortunately that wasn't an option with my most recent purchase.  Hopefully the manufacturer will bring that version back.  I tend to use this knife to cut up fruit or slice smaller sized tomatoes and it works perfectly for that.  The grip is good and I like the color options.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 29 April 2025
reviews.author: Phyllis

reviews.title: Mind your fingers
reviews.body: Razor sharp , fantastic knife. Great value. I'm looking for another a little longer
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 9 June 2026
